<translated_code>
import sys
from collections import deque

MAXN = 200
MAXM = 100000
INF = 199999999

grid = [[0]*20 for _ in range(20)]
adj = [[-1]*MAXN for _ in range(MAXN)]
n = 0
N = 0
T = 0
humans = [[0]*3 for _ in range(MAXN)]
robots = [[0]*3 for _ in range(MAXN)]
zr = 0
zc = 0
hcnt = 0
rcnt = 0
dirs = [(0,-1),(0,1),(-1,0),(1,0)]

def valid(r, c):
    if 1 <= r <= n and 1 <= c <= n and grid[r][c] != -1:
        return (r-1)*n + c
    return -1

def buildGraph():
    global N, adj
    N = n * n
    adj = [[-1]*(N+1) for _ in range(N+1)]
    for r in range(1, n+1):
        for c in range(1, n+1):
            if grid[r][c] == -1:
                continue
            p = (r-1)*n + c
            adj[p][p] = 0
            for dr, dc in dirs:
                nr = r + dr
                nc = c + dc
                if 1 <= nr <= n and 1 <= nc <= n and grid[nr][nc] != -1:
                    np = (nr-1)*n + nc
                    adj[p][np] = 1

dist = [0]*MAXN
q = [0]*MAXM
inq = [0]*MAXN

def spfa():
    global dist, q
    for i in range(1, N+1):
        dist[i] = INF
    start = (zr-1)*n + zc
    dist[start] = 0
    front = 0
    rear = 1
    q[0] = start
    while front < rear:
        u = q[front]
        front += 1
        for v in range(1, N+1):
            if adj[u][v] == 1 and dist[v] > dist[u] + 1:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                q[rear] = v
                rear += 1

def floyd():
    global adj
    for k in range(1, N+1):
        for i in range(1, N+1):
            if adj[i][k] == -1:
                continue
            for j in range(1, N+1):
                if adj[k][j] == -1:
                    continue
                if adj[i][j] == -1 or adj[i][j] > adj[i][k] + adj[k][j]:
                    adj[i][j] = adj[i][k] + adj[k][j]

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, st, ed, flow, nxt):
        self.st = st
        self.ed = ed
        self.flow = flow
        self.next = nxt

edge = [None]*MAXM
head = [-1]*MAXN
E = 0
src = 0
dest = 0

def addEdge(st, ed, flow):
    global E, edge, head
    edge[E] = Edge(st, ed, flow, head[st])
    head[st] = E
    E += 1
    edge[E] = Edge(ed, st, 0, head[ed])
    head[ed] = E
    E += 1

def buildFlow():
    global head, E, src, dest, edge
    head = [-1]*MAXN
    E = 0
    src = 0
    dest = hcnt + rcnt + 1
    for i in range(1, hcnt+1):
        addEdge(src, i, humans[i][2])
    for i in range(1, rcnt+1):
        addEdge(hcnt + i, dest, robots[i][2])
    for i in range(1, hcnt+1):
        for j in range(1, rcnt+1):
            p1 = (humans[i][0]-1)*n + humans[i][1]
            p2 = (robots[j][0]-1)*n + robots[j][1]
            if adj[p1][p2] != -1 and adj[p1][p2] <= T and adj[p1][p2] < dist[p2]:
                addEdge(i, hcnt + j, INF)
            elif adj[p1][p2] != -1 and adj[p1][p2] <= T and adj[p1][p2] == dist[p2]:
                for dr, dc in dirs:
                    rr = robots[j][0] + dr
                    cc = robots[j][1] + dc
                    pp = valid(rr, cc)
                    if pp != -1:
                        if adj[p1][pp] == adj[p1][p2] - 1 and adj[p1][pp] < dist[pp]:
                            addEdge(i, hcnt + j, INF)
                            break

d = [-1]*MAXN

def bfs():
    global d
    que = [0]*MAXN
    front = 0
    rear = 1
    que[0] = src
    d = [-1]*MAXN
    d[src] = 0
    while front < rear:
        u = que[front]
        front += 1
        i = head[u]
        while i != -1:
            v = edge[i].ed
            if d[v] == -1 and edge[i].flow > 0:
                d[v] = d[u] + 1
                if v == dest:
                    return True
                que[rear] = v
                rear += 1
            i = edge[i].next
    return False

stk = [0]*MAXN
cur = [0]*MAXN

def dinic():
    global cur, stk
    ret = 0
    while bfs():
        for i in range(src, dest+1):
            cur[i] = head[i]
        u = src
        tail = 0
        while cur[src] != -1:
            if u != dest and cur[u] != -1 and edge[cur[u]].flow > 0 and d[u] != -1 and d[u] + 1 == d[edge[cur[u]].ed]:
                stk[tail] = cur[u]
                tail += 1
                u = edge[cur[u]].ed
            elif u == dest:
                minf = INF
                for i in range(tail-1, -1, -1):
                    if edge[stk[i]].flow < minf:
                        minf = edge[stk[i]].flow
                ret += minf
                for i in range(tail-1, -1, -1):
                    edge[stk[i]].flow -= minf
                    edge[stk[i]^1].flow += minf
                    if edge[stk[i]].flow == 0:
                        tail = i
                u = edge[stk[tail]].st
            else:
                while tail > 0 and u != src and cur[u] == -1:
                    tail -= 1
                    u = edge[stk[tail]].st
                cur[u] = edge[cur[u]].next
    return ret

def solve():
    global grid
    grid[zr][zc] = 0
    buildGraph()
    spfa()
    grid[zr][zc] = -1
    buildGraph()
    floyd()
    buildFlow()
    return dinic()

def main():
    global n, T, hcnt, rcnt, grid, humans, robots, zr, zc
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    T = int(next(it))
    hcnt = 0
    rcnt = 0
    grid = [[0]*20 for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        s = next(it)
        for j, ch in enumerate(s):
            if ch == 'Y':
                grid[i][j+1] = -1
            elif ch == 'Z':
                zr = i
                zc = j+1
                grid[i][j+1] = -1
            elif '1' <= ch <= '9':
                hcnt += 1
                humans[hcnt][0] = i
                humans[hcnt][1] = j+1
                humans[hcnt][2] = ord(ch) - ord('0')
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        s = next(it)
        for j, ch in enumerate(s):
            if '1' <= ch <= '9':
                rcnt += 1
                robots[rcnt][0] = i
                robots[rcnt][1] = j+1
                robots[rcnt][2] = ord(ch) - ord('0')
    print(solve())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
